project.title: Wet Standpipe Extension and Four Additional Fire Hose Cabinets
project.subtitle: Existing wet-standpipe extension to an adjacent building using mixed-diameter Schedule 40 BI piping
project.location: Sample Project Site, Cagayan de Oro City 9000

introduction: LAVI Technologies Inc. is pleased to submit this quotation for the extension of the existing wet-standpipe system from the designated connection point to the adjacent building. The work covers a mixed-diameter, aboveground Schedule 40 black-iron piping network and four additional complete fire hose cabinets.

items.title: Mobilization, system verification, layout and safety coordination
items.description: Verify the connection point, establish the proposed work route, coordinate access and prepare the installation work zones.

items.title: Schedule 40 BI main piping backbone
items.description: Supply, fabricate, weld and install the primary aboveground main, including main-line fittings, valves and welding consumables.

items.title: Secondary piping and short FHC branch connections
items.description: Supply and install coordinated secondary lines, reducers, fittings and individual branches serving the proposed cabinets.

items.title: Pipe supports and protective coating
items.description: Fabricate and install hangers, anchors and brackets; prepare surfaces and apply primer plus red protective finish.

items.title: Complete fire hose cabinet assemblies
items.description: Each set includes the cabinet, fire hose, hose or landing valve, nozzle and standard mounting accessories.

items.title: FHC mounting and final branch connections
items.description: Install, secure and connect the complete cabinet assemblies to the new branch piping.

items.title: System tie-in and controlled shutdown
items.description: Connect the extension to the existing wet-standpipe header with isolation and restoration of normal service.

items.title: Flushing, pressure testing, commissioning and turnover
items.description: Flush the new line, perform hydrostatic and operational checks, rectify installation defects and submit turnover records.

pricing_basis: The amount shown is VAT inclusive and is based on the defined aboveground piping extension and listed equipment. Final routing and pipe transitions will be verified on site before fabrication; approved quantities outside this basis will be treated as variations.

additional_notes.heading: Payment Terms
additional_notes.text: Fifty percent downpayment; forty percent after completion of the primary installation activities; and ten percent after testing and client acceptance.

additional_notes.heading: Implementation
additional_notes.text: Approximately thirty calendar days from receipt of the downpayment, approved work route and uninterrupted site access, excluding delays beyond LAVI's control.

additional_notes.heading: Scope Basis
additional_notes.text: The work is an extension of the existing system and includes only the equipment, materials and services identified in the pricing schedule.

additional_notes.heading: Pipe Sizing
additional_notes.text: The preliminary pipe arrangement will be confirmed from the actual route, elevation, fittings and available flow and pressure before fabrication.

additional_notes.heading: Existing Equipment
additional_notes.text: Pricing assumes that retained equipment and utilities are operational and suitable for the proposed extension unless specifically included in the pricing schedule.

additional_notes.heading: Installation Access
additional_notes.text: Pricing covers ordinary aboveground access. Special lifting equipment, trenching and major civil restoration are excluded unless listed.

additional_notes.heading: Testing and Turnover
additional_notes.text: The completed extension will be flushed, pressure tested and operationally checked before turnover.

additional_notes.heading: Warranty
additional_notes.text: One year workmanship warranty from turnover. Supplied equipment is covered by the applicable manufacturer's warranty, subject to its terms.

additional_notes.heading: Variations
additional_notes.text: Concealed conditions, defective retained components and additional quantities outside the approved scope require written approval and separate pricing before execution.

additional_notes.heading: Validity
additional_notes.text: This quotation is valid for thirty days from the quotation date and remains subject to material availability at the time of order.
